semantic.justification: Native md4c block/span/text callbacks now dispatch directly to the Writer parser and actual pool items. Retains itemless stack entries, raw href attributes, ignored entity/NULL/math callbacks, image-text suppression and block-only HTML buffering. Application language uses the existing shared configured system-locale field binding. HTMLReader/CSS integration, task control ownership, graphic nodes, complete numbering format metadata and compiled Writer differential remain open.
